cmd.arch.grid_pick.desc: Makes a grid exactly along a picked drawing line of the current level; names continue the series. Tab takes every parallel line of the same drawing layer at once. Each pick is one undo step.
cmd.struct.beam_pick.desc: Places a beam of the current type on the active level along a picked drawing line. Tab takes the connected chain. Each pick is one undo step.
hint.grid_pick.one: Grid by line: pick a drawing line · Tab all parallel lines of its layer · Esc exit
hint.grid_pick.more: Grid by line: pick a line to take all parallel lines of its layer · Tab one line · Esc disarm
hint.beam_pick.one: Beam by line: pick a drawing line · Tab connected chain · Esc exit
hint.beam_pick.more: Beam by line: pick a line to take its chain · Tab one line · Esc disarm
line_pick.st.start_grid: Pick a drawing line. Tab: all parallel lines of its layer
line_pick.st.start_beam: Pick a drawing line for a {type} beam. Tab: connected chain
line_pick.st.no_layer: The drawing layers of the lines are not known yet, try again
line_pick.st.no_beam_type: No beam section in the catalog
line_pick.st.reload_warn: Created, but the view could not reload: {err}
